programmes.d: The team help Shaz and Zarqa transform their chaotic 1930s semi into an oasis of calm.

The team help a widowed mum transform her untouched house into a home to be cherished.

Phil visits a masterpiece of Elizabethan architecture set in 1400 acres of Lincolnshire parkland.
